title: A shoreline the fault has moved
text: Near Koehn Lake, a bar left by an ancient lake has been shifted sideways by the Garlock Fault. The bar is between 11,000 and 15,000 years old. Measuring how far it moved gave a slip rate of between 4 and 7 millimeters a year.
